groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.text: Why is Beth unconvinced that allergies are linked to vitamin D deficiency?

options.t: because people's diets have improved since the 1950s
because most people get enough vitamin D
because the evidence only applies in Britain

questions.text: Eliot explains that rising CO2 levels

options.t: will mean distribution of pollen over a wider area.
are having less impact on pollen than milder winters.
are responsible for higher quantities of pollen.

questions.text: What does Beth say about seasonal changes?

options.t: There is no clear short-term trend for the arrival of spring.
In general, spring is likely to continue arriving early.
Springs are becoming milder and longer.

questions.text: What point is made about the plant ragweed?

options.t: It is spreading to more countries.
It is the most widespread cause of allergies globally.
It causes the most severe type of allergy.

questions.text: Why is tree pollen a more serious problem in cities?

options.t: There is less to absorb the tree pollen.
There is not enough control over tree-planting.

groups.instruction: What comment is made about the seasonal changes in pollen in each of the following European countries? Choose FIVE answers from the box and write the correct letter, A-G, next to questions 26- 30. Seasonal changes in pollen

bank.t: greatest change recorded for oak pollen
changes identified for two pollen types only
a longer season for grass pollen
earlier start dates for all pollen types
significant change in start date of birch pollen
information only available for birch pollen
